approach: Horizontal CHS omitted: two finite welded rings with the existing twelve twin-rail radial ties carry roof plan shear. The original 8.5 kN interface/bracing allowance remains an adverse distributed G budget, without favourable mass credit. 96 simultaneous full/partial, signed and biaxial wind patterns each repeated for three gravity/suction states. Ring eccentricities, elevated facade/roof projections applied at the actual ridge purlin, 24 inclined primary legs and their 260 mm eccentric connection to the ring included. Lower passive pads release in tension; each adjacent floor strip routes residual to the two captive corners. Ground-floor plinth wind tributary and L-corner spring shears are distributed to three reference shafts with conserved yaw. First-floor cracked membrane/roof joint/soil stiffness, roof pin/purlin and local floor/arch joints and head/soil capacity remain design questions. Independent component extrema are not one simultaneous house load.
courtSWGroundElbow: Two actual 600x450 beam returns share the corner compression by equal tip displacement on their real backspans; old first-wall-only control gave P39 -23.0332 kN in gravity. This redistribution demands reinforcement around the real SW node and compatible shaft/soil stiffness. No pile count changed.
localOptionalBay: Separate unadopted reference in current-house-service-bay.json. Do not add the entire wet sled load to the bay floor. Apply its declared P36/P37 loads only if adopting that control, including moments and hydrostatic action.
